examples.condition: The outer ZIP can remain r1-named while all 121 all-premises postcode members must be corrected r2 files.
A package with r1 all-premises postcode members fails even if its total row count appears plausible.
All-premises current-r2 inventory must contain 121 files and 1,741,096 rows before a slot join is accepted.
Residential postcode files remain a separate 121-file r1 contract and cannot substitute for the all-premises r2 migration input.
Postcode full-fibre coverage must remain null because Ofcom withholds that field for commercial confidentiality.
Postcode SFBB, UFBB100, UFBB300 and gigabit percentages are area proxies and do not establish an individual parcel service guarantee.
A postcode with a termination date must be retained for identity review but cannot be silently promoted as a current live postcode.
ONS postcode coordinates and administrative codes can corroborate identity and join distance but cannot supply broadband values.
